app.name: Wii Ran AI
app.short_description: Local stories and chat on your Wii
app.long_description: Choose StoryBananaMind-7.5M for stories or BananaMind 2 Nano Chat for short multi-turn replies. Both run locally offline. D-pad moves/selects, A chooses/types, B deletes, Minus spaces, Plus generates, Home quits. 256-char input; 256-token chat context.
